column1: # The files the source-read gate's NEGATIVE CONTROL defects, and the
# commit that holds each file's DEFECTIVE (pre-migration) version.
# The set is the UNION of the twelve files review round 1 named (every
# one of them reads production source by a quoted repo-relative
# literal) and the eight files review round 2 named (the shape with no
# quoted literal at all: the path is built from the working
# directory). A control over one shape proves nothing about the other.
